verdict.rationale: GitLab documents group-level AI governance for monitoring agent sessions and audit logs [gitlab-docs-45]. Sessions record status and execution data for agents and flows a user has run [gitlab-docs-37]. Agent activities are attributed in audit logs and commit histories, but the evidence names a service account [gitlab-docs-62], not the human who triggered the agent, so per-user attribution is implied by the composite-identity feature rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation that audit events link agent actions to the triggering user, detail on audit log fields and export for agent actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
